xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5011: Composer is locked for every idle Herdr work agent: pane state 'done' (turn finished) is treated as 'ended'

plan.title: Composer is locked for every idle Herdr work agent: pane state 'done' (turn finished) is treated as 'ended'
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One mapping fixed at every consumer in one PR: leaving any one consumer (session-tree work rows, activity-route rows, cockpit tree, specialist rows) on the old rule keeps the composer locked or the row mislabeled on that surface.

narratives.Problem: The operator cannot type to an idle Herdr work agent: its Command Deck row reads presence 'ended', so SessionPanel builds sessionAlive=false and ComposerFooter disables the composer. Verified live on 2026-11-04: Herdr reported agent-pan-4841 as 'working' while GET /api/session-trees reported its work node presence 'ended'; every Herdr work node read 'ended'. Two causes: (1) work/planning/strike/knowledge rows in projects.ts:256 and command-deck.ts:331 call deriveSessionPresence with a tmux-only session-name set, which never holds Herdr panes, so it returns 'ended' on its first line; (2) pane-state mappings treat Herdr 'done' (turn finished, pane alive) as an exit: command-deck.ts nodeStatusFor (done -> ended), IssueTreeLane.paneStatus (done and unknown -> ended), and session-tree-specialists.ts (done -> active).
narratives.Proposal: Add one shared presenceForPaneState(state) to packages/contracts/src/backend-pane.ts (working|blocked -> active, idle|done|unknown -> idle, exited -> ended). Make deriveSessionPresence pane-first: when the issue's backend pane for the agent exists, its state decides presence; otherwise the old tmux/runtime logic runs. Hoist getBackendPanesForIssue above the agent loops in projects.ts and command-deck.ts and pass the pane (indexPanesByAgentKey) in; a live pane also suppresses endedAt. Route nodeStatusFor, IssueTreeLane.paneStatus and the specialist-row presence through the helper. Add regression tests at each layer, including SessionPanel handing ConversationPanel sessionAlive=true for an idle session, and document the pane-state -> presence table.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing activityForPaneState in src/dashboard/server/services/agent-state-service.ts (read-model activity done -> stopped).
- Changing pipeline/flywheel liveness: derived-issue-state.ts isLive, flywheel/derive-status.ts paneIsLive, routes/parked.ts live-pane filter.
- Making the ws-rpc tmux presence poller Herdr-aware.
- Any production change to SessionPanel.tsx, ComposerFooter.tsx or ConversationPanel.
- Herdr-aware awaiting-input detection (detectAwaitingInputForAgent stays tmux-gated).
- The synthesized tmux-only planning node in projects.ts.
- Raising any file-size allowlist row; command-deck.ts must not grow past 1329 lines.
- Updating the external OKF knowledge bundle (../overdeck-knowledge).

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the tmux-only work-row presence (deriveSessionPresence) in addition to the issue's nodeStatusFor fix.
autoDecisions.rationale: Live evidence shows every Herdr work node reads 'ended' even while Herdr reports it 'working'; the issue's suggested nodeStatusFor change only touches review/test/ship rows, so it alone would leave the operator's composer locked.

autoDecisions.summary: Backend pane state is authoritative for presence whenever a pane exists (pane-first deriveSessionPresence).
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-3917 D10 makes the terminal backend the owner of liveness; tmux hosts also yield panes from the inventory's tmux probe, and with no pane the old tmux branch runs unchanged.

Herdr lists the pane, so it is alive; 'unknown' only means Herdr did not detect the harness (pi/codex). 'idle' keeps the composer open without claiming activity and matches nodeStatusFor's existing default.

autoDecisions.summary: Put presenceForPaneState in packages/contracts/src/backend-pane.ts with an inline return union.
autoDecisions.rationale: Server and frontend both import contracts; types.ts already imports backend-pane.ts and lint:circular counts type-only imports, so importing SessionNodePresence back would add a refused cycle.

autoDecisions.summary: Leave activityForPaneState and pipeline liveness helpers unchanged; follow-up filed as PAN-5013 (Flywheel copy is PAN-4666).
autoDecisions.rationale: They drive dispatch and read-model activity, not the composer; changing them alters Flywheel/pipeline behavior and needs its own review. No pane transition emits agent.status_changed 'stopped', so the corrected presence is not overwritten.

narrative.Action: PRD W1. Do NOT import SessionNodePresence from ./types (types.ts imports backend-pane.ts; lint:circular counts type imports). index.ts already re-exports ./backend-pane. narrative.Action: PRD W3. In collectSessionTreeNodes (src/dashboard/server/routes/projects.ts): move the existing `const [treeDerived, treePanes] = await Promise.all([getDerivedIssueState(issueId), getBackendPanesForIssue(issueId)]);` (currently ~line 371) to just before the candidate loop (`for (const checkId of [...candidateSessionIds].sort(`, ~line 238) and delete the original; add `const panesByAgent = indexPanesByAgentKey(treePanes);` (import from '@overdeck/contracts'). In the loop: `const pane = panesByAgent.get(checkId);`, pass it as the 4th argument of deriveSessionPresence, add `const paneLive = pane !== undefined && pane.state !== 'exited';` and change sessionEnded to `!paneLive && (rtState?.state === 'suspended' || presence === 'ended' || (!!state.stoppedAt && !tmuxAlive))` (tmuxAlive unchanged). Leave the tmux-only synthesized planning node alone. In projects.test.ts add a partial vi.mock of src/dashboard/server/services/backend-inventory.js overriding only getBackendPanesForIssue (default async () => []), plus two cases: a registered work agent with a 'done' pane and empty tmux names -> work node presence 'idle' and endedAt undefined; same with an 'exited' pane -> presence 'ended'. Third case: a live 'done' pane while the mocked runtime state is { state: 'suspended' } and the agent state has a stoppedAt -> endedAt undefined.

narrative.Action: PRD W4. In fetchActivityDataWithContext (src/dashboard/server/routes/command-deck.ts): hoist `const issuePanes = await getBackendPanesForIssue(issueId);` (~line 424) above the agent loop (`for (const checkId of [planningAgentId, agentId, ...` ~line 285) and add `const panesByAgent = indexPanesByAgentKey(issuePanes);`. Pass `panesByAgent.get(checkId)` as deriveSessionPresence's 4th argument (~line 331). Add `const paneLive = (panesByAgent.get(checkId)?.state ?? 'exited') !== 'exited';` and change sessionEnded (~line 351) to `!paneLive && (rtState?.state === 'suspended' || presence === 'ended' || (!!state.stoppedAt && !tmuxAlive))` (tmuxAlive unchanged). Change firstPaneWithRole (~line 426) to prefer a live pane: `issuePanes.find((pane) => pane.role === role && pane.state !== 'exited') ?? issuePanes.find((pane) => pane.role === role)`. Replace the nodeStatusFor switch with: `if (!pane || pane.state === 'exited') return { status: verdict ?? 'completed', presence: 'ended' };` then `return { status: 'running', presence: presenceForPaneState(pane.state) };` with a PAN-5011 comment. Net line change must be <= 0. In command-deck.test.ts: give the deriveSessionPresence mock (line 34) a 4th `pane` param that returns the helper's mapping when set; partial-mock backend-inventory.js getBackendPanesForIssue (default []); add cases: 'done' review pane -> review section status 'running' presence 'idle'; 'exited' review pane with approved PR -> presence 'ended' status 'completed'; 'done' work pane with empty tmux names -> work section presence 'idle' and endedAt undefined. Also add cases: 'done' work pane with mocked runtime state { state: 'suspended' } -> endedAt undefined; an 'exited' review pane listed before a 'done' review pane -> review section presence 'idle'. Keeping the three changes in one item is deliberate: they share command-deck.ts, whose net growth must be <= 0.

narrative.Action: PRD W5b. Herdr pane ids (w1JA:p3) are backend handles, not agent ids, and cockpit pane rows have no hasJsonl, so SessionPanel never renders ConversationPanel (no composer) and would send to /api/agents/w1JA%3Ap3/message. Steps: (1) add `hasJsonl?: boolean;` to ActivitySection in src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/CommandDeck/ZoneCOverviewTabs/queries.ts (the activity route already sends it). (2) In IssueTreeLane.tsx paneToSession use `sessionId: pane.agentId ?? pane.id`. (3) Extract the pane/section merge from the `sessions` useMemo into `export function cockpitSessions(panes: readonly BackendPane[], sections: readonly ActivitySection[]): SessionNode[]`: pane rows first, each enriched with `hasJsonl: true` when the activity section with the same sessionId has hasJsonl; then non-pane section types via toCockpitSession, exactly as today. The useMemo calls it and keeps its legacy-planning push. (4) Tests in IssueTreeLane.test.ts: pane { id: 'w1JA:p3', agentId: 'agent-pan-4841', role: 'work', state: 'done' } + section { type: 'work', sessionId: 'agent-pan-4841', hasJsonl: true } -> one work session with sessionId 'agent-pan-4841', hasJsonl true, presence 'idle'; a pane without agentId keeps sessionId = pane.id.
